description: This is a build script written in JavaScript (Node.js) that manages build environment cleanup, invokes the build process via pnpm, parses the build output for specific errors or warnings, and handles process termination based on build success or failure.

methods.name: removeDistPluginNodeModulesSymlinks
methods.description: Removes symbolic links to node_modules within 'extensions' directories under a given root directory.

methods.name: pruneStaleRuntimeSymlinks
methods.description: Removes outdated runtime overlays by calling 'removeDistPluginNodeModulesSymlinks' on specific directories.

methods.name: findFatalUnresolvedImport
methods.description: Parses lines of build output to find unresolved import errors outside the plugin directory.
